TextBlock.Text: The coastal P-15 radar is transmitting east of your aircraft. Use passive detection to locate it, then order an AGM-88A attack.
One aircraft and one target. Clear weather, finite ammunition and no target return fire. The aircraft starts in a small holding pattern. Give it an attack order when ready.
Check the selected loadout, bay-door opening, weapon clearance, guidance and target damage. The success message appears after target destruction; the scenario remains open for inspection.
Fictional training scenario. Requires only Sea Power and this mod.
